summary: P0 signup emails bug fix VERIFIED. All 11/11 pytest tests passed. Confirmed: (1) POST /api/auth/register returns <2s non-blocking via FastAPI BackgroundTasks, (2) welcome email fires as TRANSACTIONAL (marketing=False, bypassing suppression check), (3) admin notification sent to charbel911@gmail.com sourced from ADMIN_EMAIL env var (no hardcoded address), (4) _resolve_admin_email() precedence is correct: ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL → ADMIN_EMAIL → info@bidvex.com, (5) Google OAuth callback code-path inspected — new-user branch schedules both BackgroundTasks AFTER db.users.insert_one, existing-user branch does NOT re-send welcome, (6) edge cases (duplicate email 400, missing terms_agreed 400, missing ai_disclosure_consent 400) all correctly return errors with NO email side-effects. 5 live signups executed; SendGrid returned status=202 on every welcome and admin email.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py is 1180 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting Google OAuth callback (~140 lines) and register() (~150 lines) into submodules for future maintainability (non-blocking, not a P0).
send_welcome_email correctly defaults is_marketing=False; send_template_email only consults email_suppressions when is_marketing=True — suppression bypass for transactional welcome is sound.

_resolve_admin_email() reads env vars at call-time — correctly tolerates env reloads/overrides, avoids stale module-level constant pitfall. Verified by unit test that precedence is ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL > ADMIN_EMAIL > 'info@bidvex.com'.
BackgroundTasks scheduling block is wrapped in try/except with error logging — good defensive coding; register() won't 500 if email scheduling itself throws.
Google OAuth callback correctly gates email scheduling on new-user branch only (after insert_one), so returning Google logins don't re-trigger welcome.
test_credentials: N/A — created 5 synthetic users (bgtask_test_<ts>_<uuid>@bidvex-test.com). Not deleted per request instructions.
seed_data_creation: 5 test users created in db.users via live registration (all unique synthetic emails). Admin emails delivered to charbel911@gmail.com (real inbox).
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 signup-email bug fix is fully verified and stable. If retesting: register is rate-limited at 5/minute — space out live registration tests or wait 12s between batches. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_signup_emails_bgtasks_162.py is a durable regression suite covering code-path inspection (offline) + live HTTP with log-line assertions. 5 test users remain in DB with bgtask_test_ prefix if cleanup is desired later.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a verification run for a fix already applied by main agent. Root cause of original P0 was that welcome + admin emails were either not firing on signup, blocking the response, or sending to a hardcoded address. Mitigation: moved both email sends into FastAPI BackgroundTasks (non-blocking, runs after response), kept welcome transactional (is_marketing=False → bypasses marketing suppressions), replaced hardcoded admin constant with runtime env-var resolver (_resolve_admin_email) that prefers ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL then falls back to ADMIN_EMAIL then info@bidvex.com. All verified.
